create_timestamp_message: create a Timestamp protobuf message with seconds and nanos fields for robotics messaging
serialize_timestamp: serialize a Timestamp message to bytes using the protobuf SerializeToString method
parse_timestamp: parse a Timestamp message from serialized bytes using the protobuf ParseFromString method
access_timestamp_fields: access the seconds and nanos fields of a Timestamp message for time representation
register_timestamp_descriptor: register the Timestamp file descriptor with the protobuf symbol database for lookup
